steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each message is placed on the timeline for its audience.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Audience with no message
findings.fix: Write the message for the audience

findings.title: Message with no timing
findings.fix: Set the date the message goes out

outcome.notChecked: Whether the audience reads the message.

pros: Checks an audience with no message, a message with no timing, and a channel with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the audience reads the message.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-communication-plan skill on the records for this review.
